home.aboutPreview: For over 15 years, Granite Peak Construction has delivered complex building and civil projects with uncompromising quality and service.

body: Granite Peak Construction was founded in 2009 with a single belief: that every structure should be built to outlast trends, weather, and time. What started as a small crew of three has grown into a full-service construction partner working across Gauteng.
We handle the full lifecycle of a project — planning, earthworks, civil works, structural building, finishes, and handover — which means one accountable team from foundation to final inspection.
Our work spans commercial office blocks, industrial warehouses, residential developments, and municipal infrastructure. No matter the scale, we apply the same disciplined standards to every site.
